description: Games read the student's saved vocabulary and sentences, chosen by memory state, instead of fixed stories
deviation_notes: Design changed from the plain APK arrays to PracticeInput, because the evidence must keep the flashcard record ids. Selection is FSRS due order (owner decision 1). One added task: the game briefings said "your story"; they now say "your words" and "your sentences". The Primary type check has 14 older errors (TD-16) and the architecture check fails on origin/master (TD-15).
